response.text: Buy Vendor A — its all‑in first‑year cost is $18,000 with SSO included, versus Vendor B’s $14,000 + $3,000 SSO = $17,000 recurring plus a $1,500 one‑time onboarding (first‑year $18,500), so A is cheaper and simpler in year one and avoids the extra onboarding/complexity; only choose B if you expect to keep the service long enough (about 1.5 years) for B’s lower ongoing price to outweigh the onboarding fee.
